selection.profile_definition: Set of raw symptom evidence tokens with categorical values retained; antecedents and demographics excluded.
selection.near_duplicate_metric: Jaccard similarity = |A intersection B| / |A union B|
selection.near_duplicate_algorithm: Deterministic greedy filtering after ordering exact profiles by descending source frequency; source order breaks frequency ties.
selection.representative_row_policy: For each retained symptom profile, keep its earliest source row in the test file.
selection.caveat: The 0.75 Jaccard relation is not transitive, so greedy representative counts depend on the documented ordering.

source_records_file.values_policy: All CSV field values are copied unchanged from the selected source rows.
